import sys
import statistics

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    a = a[:n]  # ensure exactly n elements
    median = statistics.median_low(a)
    print(median)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
